CLEAN_PET_FRIENDLY.identity_key: extended stay america indianapolis airport w southern ave
CLEAN_PET_FRIENDLY.exact_quote: A maximum of two pets are allowed in each suite. Height and length restrictions apply-- pets can be no longer than 36 inches and no taller than 36 inches. Larger animals or more than two pets requires property manager’s approval. Please contact the property for questions. There will be up to a $25 (+ tax) per day non-refundable cleaning fee for the first six (6) nights, per pet. Each day thereafter there is a pet cleaning fee not to exceed $15 non-refundable fee (+tax) per day, per pet. This fee is to cover the cost of cleaning guest room. If your reservation is for six (6) days or less, the pet fees for your entire stay will be due at check-in. For reservations for seven (7) days or more, the first seven (7) nights’ pet fees will be due at check-in and each seven (7) days thereafter until the end of your reservation.  Service animals will be exempt from this charge. Pe Yes. Extended Stay America Indianapolis - Airport - W. Southern Ave. offers pet-friendly rooms, so you can bring your furry companion along for your stay.

NO_AUTHORITY_ACTION.why: the Wyndham property page injects its pet policy CLIENT-SIDE: the element <span class="policy-desc pet-policy-desc"> is EMPTY in the served markup and its container carries style="display:none". No fee appears anywhere near a pet token in the static HTML. The ONLY static pet string is a UI TRANSLATION LABEL ("PET":{"en-us":"Pet-Friendly",...}) which is an amenity chip, NOT a policy -- publishing that shape as policy is the defect already recorded in PTF-PITTSBURGH-RECAPTURE-006. Resolving these needs the attended-render lane.
